Hi Amit —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're ready to create Solace Parts in our vendor master so AP can route POs and payments. To get that over the finish line can you confirm the following and attach the relevant docs?

Required items:
- Legal entity name (as registered / on Certificate of Incorporation)
- DBA (if different)
- Registered address and mailing address (if different)
- Primary AP contact name, email, phone (who will receive POs and remittance queries)
- Remittance instructions (ACH details or wire instructions) — bank letter preferred
- US tax form (W-9) for Solace Parts, Inc.

If you can drop the Certificate of Incorporation, W-9, and bank letter into this thread or the Drive link below we'll kick off the vendor record.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/procurement/solace-onboarding-2026

Goal: have master record created and first PO routed by end of next week.

Thanks —

Appreciate the speedy turnaround.
